description.en: Operations toolkit for a paired two-machine DSH setup: connection diagnosis, one-shot configuration, cross-network checks, hash-verified file transfer, and a workflow skill. Depends on device-mesh and peer-sync; ships neither.
description.zh: 双机互联的运维工具包：体检、一键配置、跨网诊断、带哈希校验的文件直传，外加一套工作流技能。依赖 device-mesh 与 peer-sync，但不包含它们的代码。
